website.note: Corporate site; no active P1/P2/P3 trial disclosed beyond completed Australia Parkinson's Phase 1

ctgov.note: Both ctgov hits cite International Stem Cell Forum (a research consortium) - not the same entity as ISCO; neither is an active ISCO-sponsored trial

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: ISCO's lead therapeutic asset ISC-hpNSC (parthenogenetic neural stem cells for Parkinson's disease) completed its Australia-based dose-escalating Phase 1 in June 2021. No active follow-on Phase 2 trial is disclosed in the 2025 10-K (filed 2026-03-30) and there is no ISCO-sponsored study on clinicaltrials.gov. Stroke and TBI programs remain preclinical. Going-concern doubt is disclosed. Commercial revenue derives from non-clinical subsidiaries Lifeline Skin Care (cosmetics) and Lifeline Cell Technology (research reagents).

excluded_legacy_terminated.status: Phase 1 completed June 2021 in Australia; no active follow-on trial

excluded_partner_owned.note: Lead sponsor Singapore National Eye Centre; ISCO not sponsor (collaborator was International Stem Cell Forum, a separate research consortium)
